title_zh: 为读书会开场选定具体反思问题

scenario.label_zh: 讨论回忆录带来的认识并修改读书会开场
scenario.goal_zh: 讨论回忆录带来的认识并选定关于机会差异的开场问题

context_zh: 朋友 Leila 与 Sam 筹备读书会，讨论一部虚构回忆录中的个人反思，未对真实群体作统计断言。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: The narrator's realization about her own privilege had a profound effect on me.

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: She had assumed every student could afford an unpaid summer placement. Then she heard why her friend couldn't take one.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: That makes a useful question for our group. How can an ordinary assumption carry prejudice?

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: I don't want the opening to sound as if we're judging the readers.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: Then ask about the scene: what opportunities did the two characters actually have?

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: Yes. I'll start there and let people connect it to their own experience only if they want to.

targets.sense_zh: 因处境或背景享有的优势
